root_cause.text: The NLMSG_DONE terminator in __nfulnl_send() was built using nlmsg_put(), which does not initialize the struct nfgenmsg payload, leaking up to four bytes of uninitialized kernel heap data to userspace when batching multiple NFLOG messages.
root_cause.evidence: The patch replaces `nlmsg_put()` with `nfnl_msg_put()` which initializes the nfgenmsg payload via `nfnl_fill_hdr()`. The CVE description explicitly states that "four bytes of stale kernel heap data are leaked to userspace in the NLMSG_DONE message body" because `nlmsg_put()` only zeroes alignment padding, not the payload itself.
